messages:
maria: Quick plan  Were launching a small PLG probe next week: surface a $15 starter balance + 3 curated playground snippets to see if onboarding friction falls. Aim: +12% day-7 activation without raising cost/activated.
john: timeline + channels?
maria: kickoff Thurs 09:00 PT, 7-day run. Channels: product banner, welcome email, and in-app modal. Split cohorts by signup_source (organic, docs, webinar).
eli: naming: call it 'starter-balance probe' in dashboards so it's distinguishable from previous credit runs.
danielle: copy ideas (short):
  variant_X: "$15 starter balance 1 quick snippets to ship a demo"
  variant_Y: "Start building: $15 on us + ready-made prompts for a PoC"
  variant_Z: "Prototype in minutes 15 in your account + curated examples"
ryan: we'll rotate subject lines too. suggestions: "$15 on Redwood 1 quick ways to validate an LLM flow" and "Your Redwood starter balance is ready 1 try these snippets"
mina: prompt snippet set (3) to show in onboarding carousel:
  1) "Given these product notes, output a 4-line launch blurb for marketing."
  2) "Summarize this meeting transcript into 5 action items with owners."
  3) "Create a short code example calling the Redwood API to embed text then search."
eli: instrumentation needs: event names and funnel thresholds. I'll define events if we lock copy.
mina: also add one-click import for playground so users can load a snippet into their sandbox. reduces friction.
john: CS playbook: one-pager + rollback steps if costs spike. I'll draft.
maria: allocation rules (sketch):
  segment_rules: "bucket by signup_source then randomize into 3 variants; starter_balance = 1500 tokens; show_snippets = true"
growth-bot: Experiment entity created: https://growth.internal/experiments/4721  Metrics tracked: day-1, day-7 activation, cost_per_activation.
eli: primary metric = day-7 activation (>=1 inference + token usage >=500). secondary: time-to-first-inference.
danielle: small A idea: include a short testimonial in the modal for 'webinar' cohort to see if social proof helps.
ryan: agree. but we should keep 1 control group with no starter balance so we can measure absolute lift.
maria: good call. control = baseline banner/email with no balance (but still standard welcome).
mina: owners: instrumentation = eli, email automation = sam (cc'd separately), modal UI = mina, CS doc = john.
maria: freeze copy + snippets Tue 5pm PT. instrumentation to be ready Wed morning.
eli: alerts: notify if cost_per_activation > baseline * 1.8 OR if day-1 activation drops.
john: we'll post experiment brief to #growth and a short blurb for customer success.
maria: success criteria to scale: lift >=12% day-7 AND cost_per_activation <= baseline *1.4. If met, we trial expanding to docs and Github cohorts next month.
growth-bot: Scheduled launch: 2026-04-06T16:00:00Z. Dashboard will populate within 1h of start.
maria: thanks everyone  check-in Friday 10am PT for interim results.
eli: noted.
mina: :rocket:
